name: Grid
summary: A CSS-grid container — a fixed column count or a responsive auto-fit, with the DS gap scale.
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-grid> — defined once, imported unchanged by React and Vue. Shadow-DOM CSS, themed only by --aha-* tokens; give it a fixed `columns` count (equal tracks) or a `min` track width for a responsive auto-fit, and `gap` takes the named steps small/middle/large (8/16/24). Layout only — it never paints a background. Zero drift.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. React (< 19) consumes it via a thin wrapper; Vue binds the custom element natively. The primitive is defined once in @ahaslides-product/design.

spec.label: Gap scale
spec.value: small 8 · middle 16 · large 24 (or a raw px number)

props.name: columns
props.desc: Fixed number of equal-width columns (minmax(0, 1fr) tracks)

props.name: min
props.desc: Minimum track width for a responsive auto-fit grid; wins over columns

props.name: gap
props.desc: Space between cells — named DS step (8/16/24) or a raw pixel number

whenToUse.when: a two-dimensional layout — a card gallery, a stat row, an image grid
a one-dimensional flow where items size to content
the column count should follow the container width — prefer it over media queries

opinion.note: Reach for `min` (auto-fit) before hand-writing breakpoints — the grid reflows itself. Keep gaps on the named scale so spacing matches the rest of the surface. Grid is layout, never decoration: it paints no background.
opinion.dsv3: COVERED — DS V3 has no measured Grid cell; spec derived from the DS spacing scale (8/16/24) + AntD Grid/Row conventions (fixed tracks, responsive auto-fit). A deliberate, documented layout extension; the only visual token it binds is inherited text colour.

snippets.label: HTML
snippets.note: The native form — a web component in an HTML file renders on open, no build step. The fast path for vibe-coding.

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI (getComputedStyle via headless CDP). Leaf = ONE shared element, single render.
